text:
jess: Planning Windstone dedicated rollout for Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC (maintenance window). Need signoff: KMS overlap, version pin, canary size, rollback thresholds. Can we lock the quiet window by EOD?

maria: I checked KMS schedule — no rotations planned that night. +1 for KMS safety.

alan_ops: Ops: propose 10% canary on 4 nodes for 30m, then 50% for 20m, full traffic after green. Rollback triggers: >1% 5m error rate OR p95 latency increase > 750ms vs baseline. Also need drain timeout set to 45s.

ryan: Confirming we should pin runtime image to v2.3.1-rc4 for this rollout. Release branch has the hotfix for kvcache leak. Will push image tag tonight.

lena: QA: we ran the smoke harness against v2.3.1-rc4 on a mirrored slice — no regressions on prompt fidelity, minor drop in embed throughput (~3%). Acceptable. We'll provide two smoke prompts to run post-canary.

jess: Thanks. Adding release notes snippet for customer and ops: 
- Pin runtime -> v2.3.1-rc4 (kvcache leak fix)
- Canary strategy: 10% (30m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100%
- KMS: no rotation during window; customer-managed KMS will remain stable
- Rollback criteria: >1% errors OR p95 +750ms

jess: Also note: Dedicated pool will be scaled to reserved slice size +20% for priming. Autoscale disabled for the window.

maria: Security acked. KMS key access logs will be retained for 90 days per compliance request.

alan_ops: Ops acked. I've prepared rollback playbook and runbook steps. Quick checklist:
1) Pause ingest to slice (if needed)
2) Shift traffic to fallback region (manual)
3) Pin clients to previous runtime tag v2.3.0
4) Drain and restart slices

jess: Can someone post the exact canary job command for deploybot so we can schedule?

deploybot: @channel deploybot scheduled job created:
```
job: windstone-dedicated-canary
image: redwood/runtime:v2.3.1-rc4
canary: 10%
duration: 30m
post-checks: smoke-prompts.txt
```

ryan: Command looks good. I'll push the pinned image tag now and update deploy manifest.

lena: Smoke prompts attached: 1) short-completion-check 2) long-context-truncation-check. QA will run automatically after canary reaches 10%.

jess: Final ask: legal wants a short customer-facing blurb. Draft: "Planned dedicated upgrade for Windstone to improve stability; expected brief latency variance during canary. No data path changes." Approve?

maria: Fine from security.

alan_ops: Ops: fine. Add contact: alan_ops oncall during window.

jess: Great. Locking quiet window. Scheduling deploybot to start Thu 02:00 UTC. If no objections by EOD, I'll mark this as approved and hit schedule. :shipit:

lena: Approved.

ryan: Approved.

deploybot: @jess deploybot confirmed schedule: windstone-dedicated-canary starting 4471523200 (Thu 02:00 UTC). Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/jobs/4471523200

jess: Thanks all — I'll publish release notes and the ops runbook link after the push.

alan_ops: copied runbook into /runbooks/windstone-dedicated.md and pinned to the release thread.
